syntax.syntax_item: answer = questdlg(question, title, btn1, btn2, default)
answer = questdlg(question, title, btn1, btn2, btn3, default)

param_input_item.param_description: Question text. Use a character vector, string, or cell array of character vectors.

param_output_item.param_description: Selected button label. Returns an empty character vector when the dialog is dismissed.

description.p: questdlg displays a question dialog and returns the selected button label.
